liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard to Handle** (1 review): Video on YouTube; Hard to Handle is solid and smoking, followed by an exploratory, well-played China Cat > Rider [8]

## The recordings

- **gd70-02-04.sbd.kaplan.14188.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 46 min; rated 3.38/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this soundboard snippet distorted and hissy, with cuts; recommends it only after better recordings are exhausted; Sound issues are prevalent across the rest of the set, though it is still worth hearing; Sound is garbled and hissy but fine for 1970 and the Great Highway venue; reviewer enjoys analog flaws [4][8][9]
- **gd1970-02-04.sbd.cotsman.12601.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 37 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1970-02-04.sbd.miller.12130.shnf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 30 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer saw the TV show of this event, with many bands who then joined together for a jam; recommends the PBS show [6]
- Reviewer asks where to find video of the PBS broadcast or audio of the Santana and Airplane sets from this show [7]
- Lists YouTube links for Hard to Handle, China > Rider, a Dead jam with Jefferson Airplane and Santana, and two Airplane songs [10]
- Invite-only show in a mini-festival organized by KQED people and Ralph Gleason, videotaped for an NET special; the club was rented [15]
- Family Dog used the Ocean Beach Pavilion ballroom as a rock club after losing the Carousel [15]
- Jefferson Airplane and Santana also performed sets at the event [1]
- Portions were televised 12-13-70 on PBS; only Hard to Handle and China > Rider from the Dead's set were broadcast [2]
- China > Rider matches this date, but the rest of the setlist doesn't match Deadbase or Deadlists, which add a Hard to Handle [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-02-04.sbd.kaplan.14188.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Recorded by PBS at the Family Dog; broadcast 12-13-70 in the documentary 'San Francisco Rock: A Night At The Family Dog' [1]
- **gd1970-02-04.sbd.cotsman.12601.shnf**: source: source 1: SBD>MR>C>D>CD; source 2: SBD>TV broadcast>MR>CD [2]
- **gd1970-02-04.sbd.miller.12130.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD>Rm>Cass>Dat>CD>EAC>SHN [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [February 4, 1970: Family Dog on The Great Highway, San Francisco, CA: Jefferson Airplane/Grateful Dead/Santana/Kimberly ](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2012/02/february-4-1970-family-dog-on-great.html) [17]
